details: differentIdeal_ne_bot' supplies nonzero relative different, so finite factor support and ideal factorization apply.

log_absNorm_eq_finsum uses exact ideal factorization, zero multiplicity off prime support, norm multiplicativity, and nonzero prime norms to take logarithms. It requires no missing positivity premise.

diffContrib_eq_sum_filter uses a bijection only on nonzero summands. Nonzero ideals over a nonzero prime give HeightOneSpectrum elements; nonzero contribution forces divisibility by the different. The LiesOver equality identifies the prime below.
The grouped identity uses finite support of the local ideal terms, distributes division over the finite sum, and groups by primeBelow over the image of the finite different support.
Finite support of diffContrib is proved separately by containment in that finite image, so the first conjunct is not inferred merely from the existence of a finsum.
No equality of the image-field and point-field degrees, no unramifiedness, and no local conductor inequality is assumed.
